identifier/ontology_id CHEBI:85146 ('carboxymethylcellulose') -> CHEBI:234035 ('carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt'). The record's own cas_rn 9004-32-4 is registered by ChEBI against CHEBI:234035, which is the sodium salt of the term the record previously carried. Curation decision on #320: where the CAS names a more specific FORM than the label, the CAS governs — the recipe is taken to mean the substance actually weighed out. These surfaced as 'unrelated' in the ancestry triage only because ChEBI does not model salt-of / hydrate-of / racemate-of as subsumption, the same gap #342 recorded for hydrates.

identifier/ontology_id CHEBI:18290 -> CHEBI:9532. ChEBI's live definition of CHEBI:18290 is 'an organic CHLORIDE SALT of thiamine(1+) diphosphate' — a counterion this record's label never mentions. CHEBI:9532 is the compound itself; 'pyrophosphate' and 'diphosphate' are the same moiety under two naming conventions, hence SYNONYM_MATCH. The term was freed by moving the 0.2% stock solution to a minted identifier per #288. The existing SSSOM row already flagged this as 'SYMMETRIC: charge/protonation/ester variant'.
